about: The "won't guess" threshold: a passage is used only when its similarity to the question (1 minus Cognee's cosine distance, from 0 to 1) is at least this. When no passage passes, the collection doesn't cover the question (covered: false). This value is a placeholder: the PoC's run (results/REPORT.md) graded retrieval by document and fact and did not record scores. Phase 0 sets it from the answerable, uncovered and near-miss question sets in test/fixtures/questions (plan ASK-02: at least 19 of 20 uncovered questions get "won't guess", and no near miss gets a confident wrong answer), using harness/run.mjs --calibrate.
